summary: @servicetitan/temporal-lite ships preinstall Bun-runtime dropper executing obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall=`node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, chmod +x's the binary, and executes it against the adjacent math_init.js — a 727KB single-line, heavily obfuscated file with a rotated string-array pool and `_0x`-style opaque identifiers (obfuscator.io shape). Invoking the payload under a freshly-fetched alternate runtime is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: the code executes on install, out of view of Node-based tooling, and its contents cannot be statically inspected. The package is published under the `@servicetitan` scope with a `github.com/servicetitan/anvil-uikit-contrib.git` repository URL but ships no functionality matching that scope's stated purpose — the tarball's only install-time effect is fetching an alien runtime and running the obfuscated blob against it. This is scope impersonation combined with install-time execution of opaque attacker-controlled code on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
